title: These Towers Are Over 1,000 Years Old. Their Kingdom Has No State #shorts
description:
Red brick towers more than a thousand years old. The kingdom that built them has no state today — but its people are still here.

Full story (9 min): https://youtu.be/nuktXZNH_fQ
